title: India Building Semiconductor Future: capabilities across design, manufacturing, packaging, materials and talent
summary: Government backgrounder describes Semicon 2.0's six strategic pillars and reports 12 approved manufacturing units, five facilities in commercial production, and 24 chip-design projects.

title: Cabinet approves Semicon 2.0 with an outlay of ₹1,27,500 crore
summary: The Cabinet approved Semicon 2.0 to deepen India's semiconductor design and manufacturing ecosystem, including equipment, materials, research and talent.

title: Twelve semiconductor projects approved across six states; three facilities reported in commercial production
summary: MeitY's release reports 12 approved manufacturing projects across six states and commercial production at Micron, Kaynes and CG Power's CG Semi facility.

title: Cabinet approves two additional semiconductor manufacturing units
summary: The government announced two additional projects in Gujarat, including a GaN-based Mini/Micro-LED display facility and a semiconductor packaging facility.

title: Government reports ten approved projects with investment commitments of about ₹1.6 lakh crore
summary: Earlier project-level snapshot with annexure details. Retained as historical context, not the latest approved-project count.
